thread:
Mia: Hey! Thinking of doing a low-key LAN this Sunday in the mezzanine — Smash (casual), Rocket League, and a retro corner. projector + ethernet?
Jon: Love it. I can bring the projector and a couple of HDMI splitters.
Devin: I’ll bring my Switch + 4 controllers. Do we need USB adapters for wired pads?
Sarah: I have a 8-port gigabit switch we can use and I’ll order pizza if people chip in 🍕
Ari: Count me in. I have a CRT adapter for SNES if anyone wants retro vibes.
Mia: Perfect. ops-bot can we book the mezzanine 4–10pm? Also need a couple of surge strips.
ops-bot: Booking confirmed: Mezzanine reserved Sun 16:00–22:00. Room capacity: 25. Equipment note added.
Jon: Poll: Smash (ultimate) vs Melee bracket? React with :one: for Ultimate, :two: for Melee.
Devin: I voted :one: but happy to set up a Melee corner if someone brings GC adapters.
Sarah: Can anyone bring ethernet cables? I have the switch but only 2 short cables.
Ari: I can bring 3 cat6a cables and a 10ft patch.
Mia: Thanks! Who wants to handle sign-up for 1v1s? I can throw a tiny Google sheet together and share.
Jon: I’ll run the bracket for Smash. Devin do you want RL tournaments?
Devin: Yep, I’ll run Rocket League brackets. Small prize = leftover company swag? :trophy:
Sarah: I’ll collect $10 per person for pizza and order from the usual place.
Mia: Awesome. Quick checklist: projector (Jon), Switch + pads (Devin), switch + cables (Sarah/Ari), snacks/pizza (Sarah), CRT adapter (Ari), sign-up sheet (Mia), brackets (Jon/Devin). Anything else?
Jon: Power strips and duct tape for cable tidy. Also can someone bring a marker for the whiteboard?
Devin: I’ve got a couple of power strips.
Ari: I’ll bring a marker.
Mia: Cool. Last call: if you wanna stream any match, reply here so we can set aside a corner.
Jon: I might stream the finals — bringing my capture card.
Sarah: Ooh, hype. See everyone Sunday! :party-parrot:
